anomalies.observed: On the CAN BUS sheet (page 7) the component at D10 is drawn as a dual optocoupler (Input/Output side with LED+phototransistor graphics) wired in series between the isolated CAN transceiver U11's CANH/CANL pins and the CAN0_P/CAN0_N bus nets. The same occurs on page 11 at D9, an optocoupler placed in series between U10's CANH/CANL and CAN1_P/CAN1_N. No CDSOT23-SM712 TVS array appears anywhere on the CAN lines.
anomalies.expected: The specification's component table states D9 and D10 are CDSOT23-SM712 TVS diode arrays placed across CAN0_P/N and CAN1_P/N for transient/ESD protection ('the netlist's CDSOT23-SM712 matches this documented choice'), and the buses are to be isolated by the isolated CAN transceiver U11/U10 itself, not by series optocouplers.

evidence.quote: `D9`, `D10` — `CDSOT23-SM712` TVS diode arrays on `CAN0_P/N`, `CAN1_P/N` | CAN bus transient/ESD protection

CAN BUS sheet, page 7: D10 drawn as an optocoupler (Input pins 1,2 / Output pins 3,4) in series between U11 CANH/CANL and the CAN0_P / CAN0_N labels; page 11: D9 likewise in series between U10 CANH/CANL and CAN1_P / CAN1_N

anomalies.impact: Optocouplers inserted in series with the CAN differential pair cannot pass the bidirectional ~1 Mbps differential CAN signal, so CAN0/CAN1 communication to the Odrive motor controllers would fail; in addition the buses lose their documented ESD/transient protection (the SM712 TVS arrays are absent).

parsed.summary: The schematic otherwise matches the specification (16 MHz crystals Y1/Y2, LTC4412 ideal-diode U6, ISL54222AIUZ U5, WS2812B LEDs, isolated CAN transceivers U11/U10, e-stop buffers), but D9/D10 are drawn as optocouplers wired in series with the CAN0/CAN1 differential pairs instead of the CDSOT23-SM712 TVS arrays the spec requires, which would break CAN communication and remove bus protection.
